missing_candidate_rounds_note: Compact records retain common_candidate_table only on round(s) where present (usually round-0000). Candidate counts do not cover rounds whose full table was not persisted. Every selected assignment across all saved rounds must be reconstructed via the separate fixed-assignment recalculation sidecar.
selected_assignment_counts_note: Round 0 count is from each source round_audits[0]. Later-round counts are included in all_saved_round_selected_assignment_count; full assignment pickup metrics belong to the independent fixed-assignment EVv2 recalculation.
